newsitem.title: FRANCE: Soc Gen buys stake in Marocaine de Banque.
newsitem.headline: Soc Gen buys stake in Marocaine de Banque.

text.p: French bank Societe Generale said on Tuesday it bought Societe Marseillaise de Credit's 9.8 percent stake in Societe Generale Marocaine de Banques.
The French bank said the purchase raised its stake in Marocaine de Banques to 45.4 percent from 35.6 percent and confirmed its interest in the Moroccan market, where it has had a presence since 1913.
It said Marocaine de Banques employs about 1,600 people and controls about eight percent of the Moroccan banking market.
In 1994 Marocaine de Banques bank earned 93.3 million francs and in 1995 it earned 106.6 million, Societe Generale said.
